provenance: Agent source review on 2026-11-02. This agent implemented the new Shared unpacking and binding proofs, not the Given chapters or their Unique formalization. It reread both Given chapters, required dependent units, the selected Unique definitions and theorem/example statements, relevant setup/helper declarations, and the review policy. The prepared packet selections were checked against these inspected source contents. Each rationale was written from that comparison before recording; neither preparation nor a passing build supplied the verdict.
rationale: Allocated is membership in object keys; Live has variable and field reachability constructors exactly matching the rules. References enumerates occurrences across all variable slots and fields, omitting empty slots. WellFormed checks distinct keys, declared field shape/order, counter bounds, strict older-target indices, Nodup references, and equality of referenced/allocated sets. Nodup plus set equality expresses the prose's exact once condition. WellFormedWith adds pending roots, consistent with the evaluation qualification. given.state/programs introduce graph components and tables.
limitations: Correspondence review compares prose, mathematics, definitions and theorem/example statements; Lean proof validity and command results are separate checks. Listing relevant source-context snapshots records definitions and assumptions consulted, not an audit of every tactic or unrelated declaration.

Finite-map notation uses the documented distinct-key and well-formedness conventions. Raw Lean list representations also admit malformed values; no functional-lookup or preservation claim is made for those outside the stated premises.
